Re-based a fourth time on 2026-09-12, still inside 0.8.0 and still pt-v19, for the three dials that close the charter's remaining acceptance criteria. market_vol_vix_excursion (a new dial, 0.0 on every preset up to pt-v18) makes the market factor's variance target read the VIX's EXCURSION above the level the index's own conditional variance implies, instead of the VIX's LEVEL against a fixed anchor: under vix_level_identity the old form read the factor's own variance back to itself, which garch-derive-design.md finding 4 measured as the loop counting its own memory twice, and cutting it takes the loop's amplification of a standing bias from 2.7x to about 1.1x and the static map from asymptotically linear to SUBLINEAR. vix_ceiling moves 80.0 to 108.63, which is vix_return_gain * GRADED_ABS_R = 17.0 * 6.39 -- the image of the range the tape grades under the fear response, derived the same way vix_target_shock_cap is derived from the clamp, and necessary because at a ceiling of 80 a down session of 4.706 per cent reached it, INSIDE the 6.39 per cent charter bar B4 requires the fear response to keep rising across; the two criteria contradicted each other until the ceiling followed the cap. market_vol_alpha and market_vol_beta move from the pt-v14 search optima 0.28035004 / 0.69244622 to the tape-derived 0.1059 / 0.8787, which carry sandwich standard errors of 0.0093 and 0.0092 where the optima carried none, and which are only transportable once the excursion dial has removed the loop's double count. The dial defaults to 0.0 and is branch-guarded, and vix_ceiling and the two GARCH coefficients keep their older values on every older preset, so pt-v1 through pt-v18 are bit-identical -- measured over seventeen presets and five seeds, 85 of 85 -- and every seeded pt-v19 trajectory changed, deliberately. metadataSha256 did NOT move, for the sixth boundary running, and neither did the DERIVED VIX ANCHOR: it reads 23.7212 on Universe.random(40, seed=111) before and after, because the unconditional identity is evaluated where the GARCH's unconditional level is its own target and neither the ceiling nor the coefficients enter it. So these three move the regime RESPONSE and the excursion dynamics and leave the level the VIX rests at alone. THE PRESET NAME DID NOT MOVE and neither default constant did; 0.8.0 is unreleased and the vector under that name is still in flight.
